# Klaviyo Pricing Review 2026: Real Costs at Every List Size (Is It Worth It?)

Klaviyo's real pricing at 500, 5k, 25k, 50k, and 100k contacts, plus the hidden costs and when the premium over Mailchimp or MailerLite is worth paying.

![Manu A.](/authors/manu.jpg) By Manu A. · May 13, 2026 · 10 min read · Updated Oct 14, 2026

Tools tested: Klaviyo Mailchimp MailerLite Omnisend Customer.io

![Editorial cost-comparison illustration: Klaviyo's pricing curve plotted against Mailchimp and MailerLite at five common list sizes, with the break-even point where Klaviyo pays for itself highlighted in rust.](/images/hero-klaviyo-vs-mailchimp.png)

If you’ve been Googling “Klaviyo pricing review,” you’re trying to answer one of two questions. Either you’re already paying for Klaviyo and the bill keeps creeping up and you want to know if you’re being overcharged, or you’re evaluating Klaviyo for the first time and trying to figure out whether the premium over Mailchimp and MailerLite is justified for your business.

This piece answers both. Real pricing numbers at five common list sizes, the hidden costs nobody flags upfront, and a decision tree on when Klaviyo is worth the premium versus when it isn’t.

> **Quick verdict.** Klaviyo is worth the premium over cheaper alternatives if you’re running an ecommerce store doing more than roughly **$10,000 per month in revenue**, you’ve integrated Shopify or WooCommerce, and you actively use abandoned cart, post-purchase, and browse abandonment flows. Below that revenue threshold, **Omnisend is about 20% cheaper at 5,000 contacts** (30-43% at 25,000-50,000) with similar feature depth on ecommerce, and **MailerLite is roughly half the price** if you just need email campaigns plus basic automations. If you’re not ecommerce, Klaviyo is the wrong tool entirely — Kit or Beehiiv for creators, Customer.io for B2B SaaS retention.

_Some links in this article are affiliate links. If you click through and sign up for a tool, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. It never affects which tools we recommend: we cover free options alongside paid ones, and we say so when a tool we like doesn't have an affiliate program._

## How much does Klaviyo actually cost?

Klaviyo’s pricing scales by two variables at once: total contact count in your account AND monthly email send volume. Most pricing reviews simplify to one axis and miss the second. Here are the real 2026 prices at five common list sizes on the Email plan (email only; SMS is a separate add-on).

| List size | Klaviyo Email plan | Monthly send included | Cost per 1,000 contacts |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 500 contacts | ~$20/mo | 5,000 sends | $40 |
| 1,000 contacts | ~$30/mo | 10,000 sends | $30 |
| 5,000 contacts | ~$100/mo | 50,000 sends | $20 |
| 10,000 contacts | ~$150/mo | 100,000 sends | $15 |
| 25,000 contacts | ~$400/mo | 250,000 sends | $16 |
| 50,000 contacts | ~$720/mo | 500,000 sends | $14 |
| 100,000 contacts | ~$1,380/mo | 1,000,000 sends | $14 |

_Klaviyo list prices, billed monthly (Klaviyo has no annual discount), verified October 2026._

Pricing is sub-linear at the contact axis (your per-contact cost drops as you grow), which is the same pattern Mailchimp and MailerLite use. The break point where Klaviyo’s per-contact cost flattens out is around 25,000 contacts. Below that, you’re paying a per-contact premium that ecommerce-driven revenue has to justify.

**SMS add-on.** There is no combined Email + SMS plan: SMS is an add-on to the Email plan, at $0.01 per SMS credit plus carrier fees (about $1 per 100 texts before carrier fees). At 5,000 contacts running modest SMS (3,000 sends per month), that’s about $130/mo plus carrier fees vs the email-only $100. At 25,000 contacts with 15,000 SMS sends per month, it’s about $550/mo plus carrier fees vs $400 email-only. SMS is the most variable line in your Klaviyo bill because SMS volume is harder to predict than email volume.

**Free plan.** Klaviyo’s free tier caps at 250 contacts and 500 email sends per month. Useful for evaluation, not useful for running a business. Past 250 profiles you’re on a paid plan immediately.

## Is Klaviyo worth the price?

The decision tree is sharper than most reviews make it sound. Three criteria, each binary.

**1\. Are you running ecommerce on Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, or Magento?**

*   Yes → continue to criterion 2.
*   No → Klaviyo is the wrong tool. Kit or Beehiiv for creators. ActiveCampaign or HubSpot for B2B with sales motion. [Customer.io](https://thestackreviewer.com/posts/customer-io-vs-klaviyo-saas/) for SaaS retention. MailerLite for general small business.

**2\. Are you doing more than $10,000 per month in store revenue?**

*   Yes → continue to criterion 3.
*   No → Omnisend or MailerLite cover most of what you’ll use for less: about 20% less on Omnisend and about half on MailerLite at 5,000 contacts. Mailchimp Standard costs the same as Klaviyo at 5,000 and only saves money from 10,000 contacts up. Klaviyo’s premium pays back through abandoned-cart recovery rate and post-purchase flow attribution, but at sub-$10k monthly revenue the absolute dollar gain doesn’t cover the price premium.

**3\. Do you actually use abandoned cart, post-purchase, browse abandonment, or back-in-stock flows?**

*   Yes → Klaviyo is genuinely worth the premium. The platform’s depth on these specific flows is the differentiator.
*   No → You’re paying for features you don’t touch. Either commit to using them within 30 days or downgrade to a cheaper platform.

If you answered yes to all three, Klaviyo is the right pick. If you answered no to any of them, you’re either using the wrong tool or paying for capacity you don’t need.

* * *

## Klaviyo vs Mailchimp vs MailerLite at the same list size

Real apples-to-apples pricing across the three platforms most readers are choosing between.

| List size | Klaviyo Email | Mailchimp Standard | MailerLite Comfort |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 500 contacts | $20 | $20 | $12 |
| 1,000 contacts | $30 | $45 | $19 |
| 5,000 contacts | $100 | $100 | $49 |
| 10,000 contacts | $150 | $135 | $89 |
| 25,000 contacts | $400 | $310 | $179 |
| 50,000 contacts | $720 | $450 | $319 |

_List prices per month, all billed monthly, verified October 2026. Mailchimp runs frequent promotions; we quote list prices. MailerLite is 10% cheaper on annual billing; Klaviyo and Mailchimp have no annual discount._

At 5,000 contacts Klaviyo’s Email plan and Mailchimp Standard cost the same, $100 a month, and Klaviyo is roughly 2× MailerLite (Comfort tier, June 2026 pricing). The gap to Mailchimp opens as the list grows: $90 a month at 25,000 contacts ($400 vs $310) and $270 at 50,000 ($720 vs $450). The gap to MailerLite holds around 2.2× at 25,000.

## 1\. Mailchimp Pricing 2026

### Mailchimp

$13–$350+/month Subscriber-based

Mailchimp is the default email tool for non-technical teams, but it has become expensive for growing lists. The company raised prices significantly in 2022 and restricted the free plan to 500 contacts — down from 2,000 previously.

| Plan | 1K contacts | 5K contacts | 25K contacts | Key Features |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Free | $0 (max 500) | —   | —   | 1K sends/mo, basic templates |
| Essentials | $13/mo | $52/mo | $230/mo | Unlimited sends, A/B testing, custom branding |
| Standard | $20/mo | $75/mo | $270/mo | Customer journeys, send-time optimization, retargeting ads |
| Premium | $350+/mo | $350+/mo | $350+/mo | Advanced segmentation, unlimited seats, phone support |

### Mailchimp Hidden Costs

*   **Transactional email (Mandrill):** Transactional emails (receipts, confirmations) require the Mandrill add-on — not included in any Mailchimp plan. Starts at $20/mo for 500K emails.
*   **Multi-audience billing:** Mailchimp counts contacts across all audiences separately. A contact in 2 audiences counts as 2 contacts. Lists grown organically easily hit the next billing tier.
*   **SMS marketing add-on:** SMS campaigns require a separate add-on with per-message pricing on top of your base plan.
*   **Website and landing pages:** The "free" website builder removes Mailchimp branding only on paid plans — $13+/mo just to remove the footer link.

### Mailchimp Price History

Mailchimp raised prices [significantly in 2022 and again in 2024](https://www.getpricepulse.com/blog/mailchimp-price-increase-2024.html), cutting the free tier from 2,000 to 500 contacts and raising paid plan prices 30–45%. Many long-term users saw bills double overnight at renewal.

## 2\. Klaviyo Pricing 2026

### Klaviyo

$20–$1,700+/month eCommerce specialist

Klaviyo is the dominant email platform for eCommerce, particularly Shopify brands. Its pricing scales steeply with list size — but ROI is often justified by deep purchase-behavior segmentation that drives higher revenue per email.

| Contacts | Email Only | Email + SMS |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Free (250 contacts) | $0  | $0 (150 SMS credits) |
| 1,001–1,500 | $30/mo | $45/mo |
| 5,001–6,000 | $100/mo | $135/mo |
| 10,001–12,000 | $175/mo | $225/mo |
| 25,001–30,000 | $400/mo | $500/mo |
| 50,001–60,000 | $700/mo | $875/mo |
| 100,001+ | Custom ($1,500+) | Custom |

### Klaviyo SMS Pricing

Klaviyo charges separately for SMS: $0.01/SMS for outbound, $0.01/MMS (multimedia), plus carrier fees. A campaign to 10,000 subscribers costs ~$100–150 in SMS fees alone, on top of the plan fee.

### Klaviyo Hidden Costs

*   **Unsubscribed contacts still count:** Klaviyo counts all profiles (subscribed, unsubscribed, suppressed) toward your billing tier. A 10K list with 30% churn effectively costs as if you have 13K contacts.
*   **Reviews add-on:** Product reviews collection requires a separate Reviews module ($25–$100+/mo depending on orders).
*   **Multiple store billing:** Each Klaviyo account connects to one store. Multiple Shopify stores = multiple Klaviyo subscriptions.

## 3\. ActiveCampaign Pricing 2026

### ActiveCampaign

$15–$229+/month Automation-first

ActiveCampaign leads on marketing automation — visual workflow builder, lead scoring, CRM integration. Best for B2B teams running complex nurture sequences. Pricing is competitive compared to HubSpot but adds up with contact volume.

| Plan | 500 contacts | 5K contacts | 25K contacts | Key Features |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter | $15/mo | $61/mo | $145/mo | Email, automation, forms, 1 user |
| Plus | $49/mo | $105/mo | $229/mo | CRM, landing pages, 3 users, lead scoring |
| Professional | $79/mo | $169/mo | $369/mo | Predictive sending, site messaging, 5 users |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Custom | Custom reporting, SSO, custom mailserver |

### ActiveCampaign Strengths

*   Best-in-class visual automation builder — complex multi-branch workflows without code

## The four Mailchimp tiers

**Mailchimp is organized into four tiers, each stepping up through features and contact limits.** Free provides basic email marketing for up to 500 contacts with 2,500 emails per month — with Mailchimp branding. Essentials at $13 per month removes Mailchimp branding, adds email templates, basic automations, and 24/7 email support. Standard at $20 per month for 500 contacts adds multi-step automations, A/B testing, 6X send volume, custom-coded templates, and advanced analytics.

Premium at $350 per month for 500 contacts adds multivariate testing, comparative reporting, priority support, dedicated IP, social ads (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram), and advanced audience insights. The pricing scales steeply by contact count — 250,000 contacts on Standard is $2,000 per month versus $350 per month for 500 contacts.

## Contact scaling and monthly costs

**Mailchimp's pricing scales predictably by contact count.** Standard tier: 500 contacts $20/mo; 5,000 contacts $100/mo; 10,000 contacts $200/mo; 50,000 contacts $480/mo; 100,000 contacts $1,000/mo; 250,000 contacts $2,000/mo. Premium tier is approximately 1.7-1.8x Standard pricing across contact counts: 50,000 contacts Premium $1,000/mo versus Standard $480/mo; 100,000 contacts Premium $1,800/mo versus Standard $1,000/mo.

Essentials tier is positioned as the basic email marketing tier for small businesses. The pricing jump from Standard at 500 contacts ($20/mo) to 5,000 contacts ($100/mo) is 5x — reflecting the per-contact scaling. Active ecommerce brands running Standard at 50,000 contacts commonly reach $480-$580 per month ($5,760-$6,960 per year).

## Overage rates and contact pricing details

**Mailchimp overage rates: $0.30 per 100 contacts over the contact cap, and $0.002 per send beyond the monthly send cap.** For example, on Standard 5,000 contacts with a 25,000 send cap, sending 30,000 emails in a month would trigger $10 in send overages (5,000 sends × $0.002). Contacts are prorated daily if added mid-cycle.

Overages can add significant costs for teams that consistently exceed their tier limits. For teams expecting contact list growth, forecasting 12-24 months ahead and selecting a higher tier is often cheaper than paying overage fees. The contact-based pricing rewards accurate list management — clean inactive contacts before they trigger overages.
